gaveUpInLine: Stood in the checkout line so long I aged. Visibly. Left without paying because I needed to see my family before they forgot my face.
The line did not move. I checked. Twice. With a scanner. Walked out with nothing but regret.
Waited in line until my oxygen tank started beeping. Gave up. The register is decorative, apparently.
I've seen glaciers on ice moons move faster than this checkout line. Put my stuff down and left.
Got in line, blinked, and a whole season passed. Abandoned my cart. Somebody else can have it.
Nobody was at the register. Or maybe somebody was, very slowly. Either way I left.
longWait: The checkout line was a spiritual journey I did not sign up for.
Great stuff, but I waited in line long enough to learn a new language. Hello in Zorbish is 'glrk'.
Checkout took forever. I made friends in that line. I made enemies in that line.
Bring a snack for the line. Maybe two snacks. Maybe a tent.
The wait to pay was so long I almost started charging rent.
Line moved at the speed of bureaucracy. Eventually got out alive.
fastCheckout: In and out of the checkout before I could even finish complaining about something.
Checkout was lightning fast. Suspiciously fast. I love it.
Paid in seconds. My ship's meter didn't even have time to tick.
Fastest checkout this side of the nebula.
missingItem: Came all this way for {item}. They did not have {item}. Why do I even have legs.
The shelf where {item} should be just stared back at me. Empty. Like my heart.
Wanted {item}. Got disappointment instead. Restock your shelves, please, I'm begging.
No {item}. I flew past three asteroid belts for this.
They were out of {item}. I will be telling my grandchildren about this betrayal.
Asked about {item}. Shelf was empty. Universe is cold and indifferent.
One star for every {item} they had in stock. Oh wait.
tooExpensive: Prices are steep. Like, cliff-on-a-low-gravity-moon steep.
Some of these prices made my wallet file a complaint.
Put a few things back after seeing the price. Then put my dignity back too.
Who prices these things, a dragon? Skipped a few items.
Love the selection, hate looking at the price tags.
priceDisgust: I saw a price tag and physically left the building. Highway robbery. Space-highway robbery.
Do they think we're made of money? Some of us are made of carbon, thank you.
The prices here are a crime. I would report it but I can't afford the call.
Walked in, looked at one price, walked right back out. Never again.
Charging that much should require a license. A pirate license.
bargain: Found an absolute steal. Felt like I robbed them. Legally!
Prices so good I checked if the tags were a misprint.
Got a deal so good I bought a second one out of respect.
Bargain city. Population: me, with a full cart.
My accountant is going to cry happy tears.
dirty: Floor was sticky. Not sure with what. Not going to ask.
Somebody please introduce this store to a mop.
Stepped over three wrappers and a mystery puddle just to reach the shelf.
Smelled like a cargo hold that lost a fight with a sandwich.
Great stuff, but the floor has its own ecosystem now.
Saw a piece of trash on the floor. It saw me back. We nodded at each other.
dirtyWalkout: Walked in, saw the floor, walked out. Some things can't be unseen.
Too filthy to shop. And I live on a mining barge.
The mess was so bad my boots filed for divorce. Left immediately.
I've been in cleaner trash compactors. Turned right around.
drab: Shop looks like a storage unit somebody forgot about. Needs some flair.
Zero vibes. Not a single decoration. Just shelves and sadness.
Felt like shopping inside a cardboard box. A grey one.
There were crates just sitting on the floor. Is this a store or a warehouse?
Would it kill them to put up a hologram or something?
gorgeous: Gorgeous shop! The decorations really sell the whole 'premium space arms' vibe.
Classiest arms dealer in the sector. I felt fancy buying ammo.
The decor here is out of this world. Literally, we're in space.
Store looks amazing. I took a holo-selfie by the decorations.
Beautiful setup. Ten out of ten ambiance, would browse again.
crateHit: GOT HIT BY A FLYING CRATE. Is that a store policy?? Is it a promotion??
Someone threw a box at my head. I'm fine. I'm not fine.
Was minding my business and a crate came out of nowhere. Bruised and confused.
The staff here throw crates like they're training for the zero-G olympics. Got hit. Ow.
Took a crate to the face. Saw stars. Five of them, which is more than this review gets.
stuck: Got completely stuck trying to walk around. Is this store a maze on purpose?
Couldn't reach where I needed to go. Somebody built this layout with their eyes closed.
Spent more time lost in the aisles than shopping. Bring a map.
Hit a dead end trying to get to a shelf. Gave up. Fun puzzle, bad store.
crowded: The line was a mile long. Everybody and their clone was shopping today.
Packed in there like ration bars in a tin.
So many people in line I thought it was a concert.
leftEmptyHanded: Left with nothing. Not one thing. Just the memories.
Walked in with money, walked out with money. Which is the opposite of how a store should work.
Could not find a single thing to buy. Great store if you collect disappointment.
changeMistake: Cashier gave me the wrong change. Math is hard, I get it, but come on.
The person at the register fumbled my money like it was hot plasma.
Had to count my change twice. It was wrong both times.
Cashier was very nice but I don't think they've met numbers before.
hunting: Had to walk to every shelf in the place to find what I wanted. Got my steps in, I guess.
Stuff is scattered everywhere. A scavenger hunt, but I'm paying for it.
Took a tour of the whole store just to fill one shopping list.
generic5: Flawless. Would get shot at with the stuff I bought here again.
Best arms dealer in the sector. Don't tell the others.
Perfect visit. My blaster has never felt more loved.
Everything was great. I'm suspicious. But it was great.
Five stars. I'd give six but the app won't let me.
Friendly staff, good stuff, no explosions. A perfect day.
generic4: Solid shop. Got what I came for, nobody got hurt. Mostly.
Pretty good! A few little things, but I'd come back.
Good selection, fair enough prices. Would recommend to my less-dangerous friends.
Nice place. Not perfect, but neither am I.
generic3: It was fine. A store. With things. That I bought.
Middle of the road. Like a moon. Not the best moon. Not the worst moon.
Mixed feelings. Some good, some bad, all very medium.
Three stars. Make of that what you will.
generic2: Not great. I've had better shopping trips in an asteroid field.
Could be worse. Could also be a lot better.
Would not recommend, unless you're out of options. Which I was.
generic1: Never again. Not even if the galaxy is ending.
Worst visit of my life, and I've been sucked out of an airlock. Twice.
Zero stars if I could. The app says I can't. The app is also wrong.

scavengers: Anyway, I'm keeping the receipt to sell for scrap.
Might come back to dig through the trash. Professionally.
mercenaries: Will update this review after I test everything on a target.
Rating based on firepower per coin.
explorers: Logged this shop on my star charts.
Adding a pin to my map, for better or worse.
civilian: Just a regular person reviewing a regular arms dealer, as one does.
My kids loved it. Is that a problem?
Was just looking for a gift for my brother-in-law.
